extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers (especially LGBTQ+ authors and allies) using AI tools / Sudowrite users
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for crafting authentic, consistent LGBTQ+ fiction using Sudowrite's features (Story Bible, NSFW generation, and plugins). Focuses on representation, intimacy, worldbuilding, and tooling to support queer narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a Story Bible (secret weapon for Queer storytelling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Story Bible — an ally in your creative process: a living source of truth that evolves along with your story, holding the threads of your narrative together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handles intricacies of gender identities, pronouns, and evolving character arcs with care and precision; it's a space to explore dynamic relationships, chosen family, and community. Use it to support authenticity and keep your story compelling as it grows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track gender identity, pronouns & arcs
rubrics_metrics.description: You can assign pronouns and identities to each character and keep them consistent across chapters. Document how a character’s gender identity might evolve, their preferred names at different story stages, and the emotional milestones they hit along the way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Especially important for stories involving trans or non-binary characters whose arcs include self-discovery and affirmation. Use these records to avoid misgendering, abrupt changes, or forgetting character development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interwoven relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Track not just who your characters are, but how they relate to one another—whether it’s a slow-burn romance between two pansexual leads or the emotional tether between a gay teen and his drag mother.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document dynamics of chosen family, queer friendship, and evolving relationships so relational arcs stay coherent and emotionally resonant across the narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural and community contexts (worldbuilding)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Story Bible to build and document the fictional or real-world queer communities your characters live in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define norms, support systems, language, and histories that shape characters’ experiences. This level of detail deepens authenticity and gives your story a lived-in, resonant feel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story Bible Remembers (consistency across AI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Story Bible creates a source of truth that helps make sure that Sudowrite won't forget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduces repeating yourself or correcting the AI; ensures names, pronouns, and continuity changes are remembered by the tool so you avoid inconsistencies introduced by the AI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable opt-in NSFW generation for queer intimacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Sudowrite enables opt-in NSFW generation through a private, respectful, and writer-first lens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows creation of intimate scenes authentic to your characters without judgment, censorship, or AI refusal — from tender first kisses to explicit erotica for queer adults. Use opt-in controls to keep creation private and respectful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customizable heat levels
rubrics_metrics.description: You can tailor the level of heat in a scene—from sweet and suggestive to fully explicit—so that it aligns with your tone, genre, and audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust heat to fit the story’s genre and intended readers; the AI should respect boundaries and the desired level of explicitness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive pleasure
rubrics_metrics.description: Write pleasure that isn’t constrained by gender binaries; craft intimacy that reflects a spectrum of bodies, identities, and orientations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portray queer intimacy with depth, joy, and agency. Avoid one-size-fits-all depictions; ensure scenes reflect varied experiences and pleasures across identities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supportive community and classes
rubrics_metrics.description: Sudowrite runs free live classes almost every day and hosts a community Discord with over 15,000 authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use educational offerings and community feedback (including classes on queer erotica) as part of developing skill, receiving critique, and staying connected to other LGBTQ+ writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender consistency checkup (Plugin)
rubrics_metrics.description: A smart assistant that analyzes your text to ensure consistent usage of pronouns and gendered terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ideal for maintaining clarity and respect in character portrayal across stories with diverse gender identities; flags inconsistencies for revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series outline generator: gay encounters (Plugin)
rubrics_metrics.description: Generates structured, gay-themed series outlines with chapter-by-chapter summaries and built-in LGBTQ+ elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Streamlines planning for multi-book narratives and ensures LGBTQ+ elements are integrated across the arc of a series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitivity reader: gender & sexuality (Plugin)
rubrics_metrics.description: A content-sensitive reader that scans your writing for potential pitfalls related to gender and sexuality, surfacing flagged areas and revision suggestions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use it to identify problematic portrayals, suggest more thoughtful phrasing, and help portray identities thoughtfully and inclusively. Treat it as a supplement to (not a replacement for) human sensitivity readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write a gay spicy novel (Plugin)
rubrics_metrics.description: A genre-specific generator that crafts romantic or erotic scenes with gay characters, producing scene ideas, dialogue, and plot details aligned with LGBTQ+ romance tropes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good for jumpstarting scenes, dialogue, and trope-aligned plot points in spicy queer fiction; customize output to match voice, heat level, and authenticity needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim for authenticity and thoughtful representation
rubrics_metrics.description: LGBTQ+ stories should be authentic, deeply human, vital, defiant, and celebrate the complexity, beauty, and strength of queer storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Story Bible, NSFW tools, and plugins to support voice and consistency; prioritize lived-in worldbuilding, nuanced characterization, and respectful portrayals that shape how readers understand queer lives.
